title: sessions.subscribe
description: The hub's roster subscription (plan 032 §3.6). The reply is the roster at a cursor and the subscription's id, written before any of its roster notifications; each notification then carries the net change since the cursor the subscriber last had. One per connection: a second is bad_request, reason already_subscribed. It ends with a reset (slow_consumer, hub_closing) or with the connection. A host answers unsupported, reason roster_unsupported (connection capability rosterSubscribe: false).

subscription.description: The subscription's id, which every roster notification and its reset carry.

epoch.description: The hub's incarnation (its endpoint.hostId): a new epoch, after a reconnect, reseeds.

cursor.description: The hub's roster sequence the sessions were read at.

truncated.description: The roster was cut at 512 rows; absent otherwise.
